_schema: Per-exercise text overrides, keyed by app id (a11…b27). Fields: equipment, setup, execute, note — each replaces that card's text in the app on next launch. Coach Claude edits this file via the GitHub API (program domain); no app rebuild needed for copy changes. Exercise NAMES are structural (they appear in logs and payloads) and are deliberately not overridable — name changes go through app builds. Blank/omitted fields fall back to the baked-in text.
